categories.main_business_segments: WindSun Science Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in five business segments: motor drive and energy-saving control, power quality monitoring and management, high-end rail transit equipment, coal mine explosion-proof and intelligent control equipment, and smart energy storage equipment. These products serve industries including power, coal, cement, metallurgy, mining, rail transit, photovoltaic power generation, wind power, petroleum, chemical, and municipal sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on high-power power electronics energy-saving control technology, with core technologies including ultra-large scale power unit cascaded H-bridge technology, big data monitoring and modular redundancy, multi-machine parallel intelligent operation, adaptive grid compensation, vector control, oscillation suppression, multi-machine master-slave control, fast start technology, and advanced inverter and energy storage control methods. Production employs a combination of assembly line and work island methods, with standardized modular production of power units and in-house control of core processes such as PCB design, software development, assembly, and testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include central and state-owned enterprises such as State Power Investment Corporation, China National Nuclear Corporation, China Huaneng Group, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, and China Development Bank. The company serves industries like wind power, photovoltaic power stations, new energy generation, rail transit, mining, petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, and municipal infrastructure, with products widely used in energy, industrial, and infrastructure sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with domestic sales accounting for the vast majority of revenue. It has established marketing and service networks covering the entire country, with some international sales and overseas customers. Key operational bases and subsidiaries are located in Shandong Province (headquarters), Suzhou, and Qingdao.
categories.supply_chain_position: WindSun operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power electronics supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of power electronic equipment and integrated energy solutions. It manufactures core components and assembles final products, providing customized solutions and after-sales services to end users and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on innovation in high-voltage dynamic reactive power compensation devices, high and medium voltage frequency converters, smart energy storage systems, and rail transit energy feedback devices. It pursues breakthroughs in energy storage technology, digital transformation, and product integration, collaborating with universities and research institutes to enhance technological capabilities and intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products such as frequency converters, SVG devices, energy storage systems, and rail transit energy feedback equipment. The company also uses a small proportion of distributor sales. Pricing is based on production cost plus reasonable profit margins, with staged payment terms including prepayments, delivery payments, and warranty retention.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in high-voltage dynamic reactive power compensation devices and high-voltage frequency converters, competing with international giants like ABB and Siemens in technology. It is recognized as a national champion in manufacturing and a leader in the domestic market for its core products, with strong brand recognition and technological advantages in the power electronics and new energy equipment sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, WindSun achieved operating revenue of approximately 1.92 billion RMB, representing a 12.75% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 174 million RMB, up 5.27%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with total assets exceeding 3 billion RMB and a solid cash flow position. R&D investment accounted for about 4.5% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: WindSun differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines covering the entire energy chain from energy saving to storage and explosion-proof solutions, and strong customization capabilities. The company emphasizes high product quality, reliability, and after-sales service, supported by a robust R&D team and multiple national-level technology platforms. Its products contribute to energy efficiency, grid stability, and renewable energy integration, aligning with national green and low-carbon development goals.
